description: A shell script for comparing the size of OpenWrt packages against upstream data, including configuration diffing and size calculations.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Displays help message extracted from script comments.

methods.name: package_size
methods.description: Calculates size of a package, either installed or uninstalled, from a given index file.

methods.name: compare_sizes
methods.description: Compares local and upstream package sizes, outputs differences and total change.
